incident.short_description: Cannot browse internet or access cloud services
incident.description: User reports no internet access on office workstation. Browser shows errors for all sites and cloud apps are unreachable. Other devices on the same network work fine. Started this morning after a restart.

notes: Matches KB0010010 'No internet connection'.

incident.short_description: VPN authentication fails after password change
incident.description: VPN client shows 'authentication failure' when connecting from home network. User reset their domain password yesterday and VPN has failed ever since. Error mentions authentication rejected.

notes: Matches KB0010082 'VPN authentication failure after password reset'.

incident.short_description: Outlook will not open
incident.description: Double-clicking Outlook does nothing; the mail client window never appears. Webmail works fine. Started after the latest Office update. Needs steps to get the desktop mail client opening again.

notes: Matches KB0010015 'Outlook or mail client not opening'.

incident.short_description: Email not sending or receiving
incident.description: No new mail arrives and sent messages never leave the outbox. Webmail shows the same problem, so it is not just the desktop client. Account was working fine last week.

notes: Matches KB0010077 'Email not sending or receiving'.

incident.short_description: Printer shows offline and will not print
incident.description: Network printer appears offline in Windows and print jobs pile up in the queue. Printer power light is on and others can print to it. Needs offline-printer troubleshooting.

notes: Matches KB0010021 'Printer offline or cannot print'.

incident.short_description: OneDrive files not syncing
incident.description: OneDrive shows sync errors and SharePoint files never finish uploading. Cloud icon displays a red cross. Local files are fine. Started two days ago.

notes: Matches KB0010025 'OneDrive or SharePoint sync failure'.

incident.short_description: Received a suspicious phishing email
incident.description: User received an email claiming to be from IT asking to click a link and enter credentials. The sender address looks wrong. Wants to know how to report it and whether the mailbox is safe.

notes: Matches KB0010026 'Phishing email reported'.

incident.short_description: Possible malware infection on laptop
incident.description: Antivirus flagged a suspicious file and the laptop now shows pop-ups and strange slowdowns. User may have opened a malicious attachment. Needs malware suspicion handling steps.

notes: Matches KB0010027 'Suspected malware infection'.

incident.short_description: No audio or video in Teams meetings
incident.description: In Teams and Zoom calls nobody can hear the user and the camera shows a black screen. System sound works outside meetings. Needs meeting audio-video troubleshooting.

notes: Matches KB0010030 'Teams or zoom audio-video issue'.

incident.short_description: Software update keeps failing to install
incident.description: The latest software update downloads but fails during installation with an error code, then rolls back. Retried three times. Needs update-failure troubleshooting.

notes: Matches KB0010031 'software update failure'.

incident.short_description: Low disk space on C drive

notes: Matches KB0010033 'low disk space'.

incident.short_description: Computer freezes and crashes daily
incident.description: Workstation freezes completely once or twice a day and twice showed a blue screen. Happens under normal office workload. Needs freeze and crash diagnostics.

notes: Matches KB0010034 'computer freezes or crashes'.

notes: Matches KB0010080/KB0010088 'Access denied to resource' (duplicate topics; either is a valid hit).

notes: Matches KB0010081/KB0010092 'Locked out, unable to sign in' (duplicate topics; either is a valid hit).

notes: Matches KB0010094 'MFA failure after phone change'.
